name: wmkf_granteedeliverable-waiver-consent
_comment: Grantee publication-waiver consent capture (2026-07-09). Mirrors the reviewer Stage-2a policy-ack pattern in wave3/04: a version LOOKUP pins the exact wmkf_policyversion the grantee acknowledged, plus a companion DateTime. Depends on wmkf_policyversion (wave3) and wmkf_granteedeliverable (wave3-grantee-deliverable-table) already existing; deploy this standalone wave after both. Reverses the original GRANTEE_PORTAL_SPEC 'no consent fields persisted' decision (see docs/GRANTEE_WAIVER_VERSIONING_PLAN.md).

attributes.description: Timestamp when the grantee acknowledged the publication waiver at deliverable submit. Companion to the wmkf_WaiverPolicyVersion lookup, which pins the specific policy version row the grantee saw.

SHA-256 hex of the waiver policy body text the grantee actually saw at submit (from the signed render token). Persisted alongside the wmkf_WaiverPolicyVersion lookup so an audit can prove the exact acknowledged text and detect any later in-place edit of that version's body (stored hash != current wmkf_policybody hash). Policy versions are immutable by convention — this makes a violation detectable after the fact.

relationships.lookupDescription: The exact wmkf_policyversion row (grantee-waiver slot) the grantee acknowledged at submit. Pinning the specific child preserves what the grantee actually saw, even if staff later activate a different version on the parent. Default Restrict cascade prevents hard-delete of referenced version rows.
